content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name] and need to use it for a project, but I'm a bit confused. I need to add hardware consisting of the following PLC: [article_no] and these modules: [article_no], [article_no]. The setup process seems quite different from other platforms like TIA Portal, as I only find a generic hardware selection and am not sure how to choose the right components. Could someone explain how to add these modules to the project? Also, a link to the programming manual for [product_name] would be very helpful. Thanks!

With [product_name], you don't have the same hardware configuration process as you would with other platforms. In the hardware selection, you simply select the correct base module. Your module matches [product_name] [version_no]. For the software, use [product_name] [version_no]. Whether you can use certain expansion modules depends on the series compatibility, which can be checked by the end of the order numbers—your specified extension modules work with the base module. These are expansion modules of the [version_no] series. Edit: [document] Edition 11/2017
Thanks for your response! How did you determine that my hardware was the [version_no]? Where can I find that information? This part still isn’t clear to me. Thanks!

Your base module is a [product_name] [version_no] (as indicated by the order number), which is the latest model. The newest software is [product_name] [version_no]. The most recent hardware module in the software is the [version_no]. Therefore, you should select the FS4 as it corresponds to your hardware model.

analysis.insight_summary: Users moving from other automation platforms find [product_name]'s hardware configuration process less detailed and somewhat confusing due to the generalized hardware selection method. The setup interface in [product_name] software isn't as explicit regarding module selection, which creates uncertainty about picking compatible modules and checking their order numbers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a more detailed and clear hardware configuration similar to what’s available in other automation software, guidance for selecting modules and ensuring compatibility by article numbers, and easy access to technical documentation.
